data.title: Oxiconazole nitrate 1% cream
data.body:
_Topicals · I Antifungals — Azoles_

**Class:** Imidazole antifungal

## Mechanism of action
- Inhibits ergosterol synthesis; good stratum corneum retention allows once-daily use

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Tinea pedis, corporis, cruris
- Pityriasis versicolor

## Dose & formulations
- Once or twice daily: 2 weeks (corporis/cruris, versicolor), 4 weeks (pedis)

## Adverse effects
- Itching, burning, irritation (uncommon)

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity

## Pregnancy & lactation
Limited data; minimal absorption.

## Viva points
- Once-daily imidazole for dermatophytosis and PV

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.42; Khopkar ch.19. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
